relationships.subject: TRPV1 V527M
relationships.evidence_quote: the V527M mutation decreases capsaicin-induced desensitization

relationships.subject: bradykinin
relationships.evidence_quote: Our results show that V527M enhances BK-induced sensitization of TRPV1 channels.

relationships.subject: 12-HETE
relationships.evidence_quote: the response to 12-HETE was significantly increased in V527M-transfected neurons compared with WT

relationships.subject: BCTC
relationships.evidence_quote: in the presence of the TRPV1 antagonist BCTC (100 nM) the effect of 12-HETE and capsaicin was completely abolished

key_findings: TRPV1 V527M from a corneal neuralgia patient is gain-of-function for acidic pH and heat, with reduced capsaicin desensitization
V527M enhances bradykinin- and 12-HETE-induced sensitization and lowers firing threshold in trigeminal neurons
